findings.title: Assert the new exit-code contract in distribution tests
findings.body: This PR changes the incompatible-update exit code from 4 to 3 and assigns 4 to a disabled feature, but the disabled-feature and incompatible-version tests only assert error text. They would still pass if either command returned success or the wrong exit code. Since automation is explicitly instructed to rely on exit codes rather than messages, assert exit code 4 for disabled-feature invocations of both metadata and check, and exit code 3 for the incompatible-version checks.
